calibration_limitations: Directional score uses fixed, judgement-set weights on price-only signals; coefficients are NOT walk-forward fit to realized outcomes.
Confidence is a heuristic strength/coverage gauge, NOT a calibrated probability; it is capped at 0.6 until out-of-sample probability calibration (Brier/log-loss) is added.
Expected return is damped trailing-horizon momentum shrunk by 0.4; it is a conservative proxy, not a calibrated point forecast.
Price-only feature set: no fundamentals, macro, earnings, or sentiment inputs are wired in yet.
